source_rules: Daily-to-H1 is a baseline Sharp Turn alignment
Sharp Turn requires an FVG into the higher-timeframe FVG followed by an FVG out
participation is on the outbound/second FVG after confirmation
full swing extreme is an allowed stop reference
killzone participation is ideal rather than mandatory
entry style after outbound-FVG confirmation is left to the trader
engine_conventions: FVG-only proxy for Monthly/Weekly/Daily directional alignment
latest completed unmitigated FVG defines active direction before first encounter
inbound FVG gap interval must intersect the Daily context FVG
outbound FVG candle-three close must exit the Daily FVG in trade direction
entry is immediate at first tradable M1 price after outbound H1 candle completion
stop is full known H1 interval extreme from inbound sequence start through outbound completion
no break-even or trailing in baseline

market_data.instrument_identity: OANDA US Nas 100 CFD/proxy; not CME NQ futures equivalence

fvg.bullish: on completed candles c1,c2,c3: c3.low > c1.high; gap=[c1.high,c3.low]
fvg.bearish: on completed candles c1,c2,c3: c3.high < c1.low; gap=[c3.high,c1.low]
fvg.knowledge_time: end/close time of completed candle c3
fvg.active_context: latest completed FVG not yet intersected by any later complete candle high-low range before the evaluated encounter

direction.selector: latest active FVG direction on each required timeframe immediately before the Daily context first encounter
direction.long: M, W and D are all bullish
direction.short: M, W and D are all bearish

daily_context.selection: chronological first encounter of each eligible Daily FVG whose pre-encounter M/W/D directions align
daily_context.encounter: first later complete H1 candle whose high-low range intersects the Daily FVG price interval

long.inbound: first bearish H1 FVG after/on Daily encounter whose gap interval intersects the Daily FVG
long.outbound: first later bullish H1 FVG whose c3 close is > Daily FVG upper bound

short.inbound: first bullish H1 FVG after/on Daily encounter whose gap interval intersects the Daily FVG
short.outbound: first later bearish H1 FVG whose c3 close is < Daily FVG lower bound

sharp_turn.multiple_outbound_policy: first causally completed qualifying outbound FVG only

entry.knowledge_time: Sharp Turn outbound H1 c3 close
entry.entry_bar: first complete OANDA M1 BID/ASK candle whose start is >= trigger knowledge time
entry.long_base_fill: ASK open plus 0.5 index points adverse slippage
entry.short_base_fill: BID open minus 0.5 index points adverse slippage
entry.long_stress_fill: ASK open plus 1.0 index points adverse slippage
entry.short_stress_fill: BID open minus 1.0 index points adverse slippage

risk.stop_anchor: full H1 known interval extreme from inbound FVG c1 through outbound FVG c3 inclusive
risk.equal_extreme_tie: same price; preserve earliest timestamp for audit only
risk.long_stop_event: first eligible M1 bar with BID low <= stop_anchor
risk.short_stop_event: first eligible M1 bar with ASK high >= stop_anchor
risk.gap_stop_fill: use adverse M1 open when open is beyond stop, otherwise stop anchor, then apply adverse exit slippage

target.long_event: first eligible M1 bar with BID high >= target
target.short_event: first eligible M1 bar with ASK low <= target
target.fill: target price adjusted by adverse exit slippage; favorable gap improvement is not credited

intrabar_order.entry_minute_events: entry occurs at M1 open; subsequent high/low events may resolve trade in same M1 bar

holding.reason: no source-grounded holding expiry; avoid adding arbitrary timeout before outcome access

economics.spread: historical OANDA ASK entry / BID exit for longs and BID entry / ASK exit for shorts
economics.classification: market-microstructure measurement assumptions frozen before V4 outcome access; not Sharp Turn semantic parameters

staged_access.stage_1: reconstruct M/W/D/H1 structure and enumerate Sharp Turn triggers only
staged_access.stage_2: seal trigger ids, context ids, directions, stop anchors and knowledge timestamps
staged_access.stage_3: only after stage-2 merge, retrieve M1 BID/ASK windows needed for sealed triggers
staged_access.stage_4: evaluate frozen base/stress economics exactly once

classification_rules.EDGE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: sample >=100 and one or more PRELIMINARY_HISTORICAL_EDGE conditions fail

interpretation.historical_result_can_establish: evidence for or against this frozen V4 measurement family on the specified OANDA historical window
